query: UPDATE blogs SET content = REPLACE(content, '<div class="bg-sky-50 border-l-4 border-[#7BDDE5] p-6 my-8 rounded-r-lg">', '<div class="callout-box bg-sky-50 border-l-4 border-[#7BDDE5] p-6 my-8 rounded-r-lg">') WHERE content LIKE '%<div class="bg-sky-50 border-l-4 border-[#7BDDE5] p-6 my-8 rounded-r-lg">%' AND content NOT LIKE '%callout-box%';
